svg.text: IRIS V-next V6 — Observation Contract + Residual-Field Safety + Controlled Capacity Ladder
Guaranteed exact-camera mode is separated from external best-effort input. Camera uncertainty never hides inside the depth authority.
OBSERVATION CONTRACT V1 — UPSTREAM OF IRIS
MODE G — GUARANTEED / CONTROLLED
8 × 1024 RGBA + exact orthographic cameras; unmodelled camera tolerance = 0.
Current research/product guarantees apply here.
MODE E — EXTERNAL / BEST-EFFORT
Artist/AI/approximate views → ObservationPreflight → CameraQualification U_v → consistency gate → IRIS / abstain.
No external 41°/51° set is silently relabelled as “known exact camera”.
Future uncertain-camera hull — separate contract version
V_hull^robust = ∩_v ∪_(c∈U_v) backproject(S_v+, c)
Union over admissible camera poses preserves conservatism; single estimated camera can over-carve.

Cross-view Observation Quality
Q_XV fixed family score; future Mode-E threshold rule: tau_XV = Q99 on OBS_CAL_V1 Mode-G calibration families.
Numeric value is not invented before calibration data opens; Q_XV is model-aware and not independent proof of input contradiction.
No-pass may version ONE lever: consumer robustness, ObservationContract/render/camera/view domain, or IRIS geometry contract.
